maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from per-hire background checks, identity verification and drug screening for employers, not servicing installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private employers (Fortune 500 companies, credit unions, Compass Group) paying for hiring screening.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling screening and identity services to employers; acquisitions such as Sterling are occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Screening is integrated with customers' ATS/HCM systems and supports compliance (FMCSA, ACA, I-9), so switching causes disruption.
